notes: Builds a single glyph-atlas texture from the 256-entry `spriteImages` array (packed into a 16x16 grid, cell size = max glyph width/height): when `useAlphaOnlyAtlas` is true, packs an 8-bit alpha-only ByteArray atlas via CubemapTextureFactory.method3583 (aBoolean6512=true); otherwise packs a 32-bit ARGB IntArray atlas via InvertTextureNode.method3132 (aBoolean6512=false). Then creates a companion GlDisplayListFont(renderer, 256) and, for each of the 256 glyphs, opens a display list (GlDisplayListFont.method595/beginCharacterList), emits a textured quad (glBegin/glTexCoord2f/glVertex2i/glEnd) mapping that glyph's atlas cell, and closes the list (method591/endCharacterList) - i.e. this is the GL-immediate-mode/display-list glyph-rendering strategy, one precompiled quad-drawing list per character. Instantiated from OpenGlRenderer.kt:878 and used directly by several material-pass classes (CubeMapMaterialPass, ScrollTexMaterialPass, SphereMapMaterialPass, TexGenMaterialPass, WaterMaterialPass) which build their own private GlDisplayListFont(renderer, 2) for a 2-slot overlay-quad trick, separate from this class.
